not_applicable.out-inside-cleaned-folder: the tool empties no folder it did not make itself, and --out is its only folder option

known_limits.json-deep-arrays.json: C: a file nested 20,000 deep makes its check fail with a RecursionError line in the report instead of a message naming the file; nothing is lost.
known_limits.json-deep-objects.json: C: a file nested 20,000 deep makes its check fail with a RecursionError line in the report instead of a message naming the file; nothing is lost.
known_limits.SharedTest-SelfMaster.esm: C: a plugin that lists itself as a master is not reported as a problem; the master rules ignore the self-reference and the run is not harmed.
known_limits.SharedTest-CutBody.esm: C: only the plugin header is read, so a plugin cut short after its header is not noticed.
known_limits.s-long-path-prefix: C: a Windows long-path prefix (\\?\) is not treated as the same folder as the plain spelling.
known_limits.SharedTest-OversizeCut.esm: C: a plugin header whose XXXX size marker claims more bytes than the record holds is read as far as it goes, with no warning.
